content:
The doctors can be assigned in \(3! = 6\) ways.  
For the nurses, choose the school receiving 2 nurses: \(\binom{3}{1}=3\). Choose the 2 nurses: \(\binom{4}{2}=6\). Assign the remaining 2 nurses to the remaining 2 schools: \(2! = 2\).  
Nurse assignments: \(3 \cdot 6 \cdot 2 = 36\).  
Total: \(6 \cdot 36 = 216\).

\boxed{216}
